provenance.caveat: A local reconstruction of the documented source ONNX is not proof that the compiled board binary contains these tensors. Clean agreement with the device does not establish gradient fidelity, and the matched surrogate remains approximate because quantisation is under test. Read from the board with sha256sum on 2026-11-04 (npu_remote.py --context-hash --spec configs/resnetv2_50_graph_spec.json). This identifies the binary that produced the attack numbers; it does not prove that the local resnetv2_50_int8.dlc or the documented source ONNX produced it. SshQnnTransport verifies every run against this value and fails on mismatch.
